spells.name: Súng Đinh Tán
spells.how: Rút súng đinh tán bắn liên thanh 5 phát vào địch.
spells.vis: a red-hot rivet bullet with a puff of steam behind
spells.guide: frames 1-4: the rivet flying to the RIGHT (seamless loop, centered); frames 5-8: a spray of metal sparks
spells.pose_txt: aiming a chunky brass rivet gun forward with both hands, recoiling with each shot

spells.name: Lựu Đạn Bánh Răng
spells.how: Ném vòng cung một quả lựu đạn bánh răng, rơi trúng chỗ địch đứng rồi nổ.
spells.vis: a round gear-shaped grenade with a sparking fuse
spells.guide: frames 1-4: the grenade tumbling in the air (seamless loop, centered); frames 5-8: an explosion with flying little gears
spells.pose_txt: an overhand lob: the arm swung back behind the head, then arcing forward and up to toss a grenade

spells.name: Tháp Pháo Hơi Nước
spells.how: Đặt một tháp pháo hơi nước trước mặt, tự bắn địch 6 phát trong 3 giây.
spells.effect: Tháp pháo có 20 máu, địch đánh trúng sẽ phá
spells.vis: a small brass tripod steam turret standing on the ground
spells.guide: standing on the ground line at the bottom of the cell, barrel pointing RIGHT; frames 1-4 unfolding its legs and rising; frames 5-8 firing in a loop (muzzle flash on 5 and 7, steam puffs)
spells.pose_txt: kneeling down and setting a machine on the ground with both hands, tightening it with a wrench
spells.guide2: frames 1-4: the bullet flying to the RIGHT (seamless loop, centered); frames 5-8: a small spark burst

spells.name: Mũi Khoan Ngầm
spells.how: Đấm xuống đất phóng mũi khoan chạy ngầm, trồi lên đâm thủng chân địch.
spells.vis: a spinning brass drill bit moving through the ground
spells.guide: frames 1-4: only the drill tip poking out of the ground line at the bottom of the cell, moving to the RIGHT with flying dirt (seamless loop); frames 5-8: the drill bursting fully up out of the ground then sinking
spells.pose_txt: a hammer punch straight down into the ground with one fist, crouching low

spells.name: Nam Châm Kéo
spells.how: Phóng nam châm khổng lồ bám vào địch rồi giật mạnh, kéo địch lại gần.
spells.effect: Kéo địch lại gần 90 px, ngắt phép đang niệm
spells.vis: a big red horseshoe magnet with magnetic field lines
spells.guide: frames 1-4: the magnet flying to the RIGHT, open end forward (seamless loop, centered); frames 5-8: magnetic pulse rings
spells.pose_txt: firing a magnet launcher forward with an outstretched arm, then yanking both hands back hard as if pulling a rope

spells.name: Xả Hơi Nóng
spells.how: Mở van ống xả trên lưng, phun luồng hơi nóng thẳng vào địch, 4 nhịp bỏng.
spells.effect: Bỏng: giảm hồi máu 50% trong 3 giây
spells.vis: a gushing jet of hot white steam with orange heat glints
spells.guide: every cell is ONE horizontal segment of the steam jet entering at the exact middle of the left edge and leaving at the exact middle of the right edge (tileable); frames 1-6 billowing; frames 7-8 thinning
spells.pose_txt: bracing low and pointing a big brass nozzle forward with both hands, leaning back against the pressure

spells.name: Không Kích Khinh Khí Cầu
spells.how: Bắn pháo hiệu gọi khinh khí cầu bay ngang trời, thả 4 quả bom xuống quanh địch.
spells.effect: Mỗi quả bom đẩy lùi nhẹ
spells.vis: a black iron bomb with brass fins falling, then exploding
spells.guide: frames 1-4: one bomb falling from the TOP of the cell, fins up; frames 5-8: exploding on the ground line at the bottom of the cell with dirt
spells.pose_txt: firing a flare pistol straight up into the sky to signal an airship

spells.name: Quá Tải Lõi Hơi
spells.how: Mở hết van lõi hơi trên lưng: bánh răng quay quanh người tạo giáp, phép kế tiếp mạnh hơn.
spells.effect: Giáp 20; phép kế tiếp +30% sát thương
spells.vis: a ring of spinning brass gears around the caster with steam venting up
spells.guide: centered in the cell: frames 1-3 gears appearing; frames 4-6 spinning with steam puffs at the top; frames 7-8 fading
spells.pose_txt: a power-up flex: fists clenched low at the sides, then thrown out as steam bursts from the backpack
